effects.printed_clause: If you control Pumpking the King of Ghosts: You can Special Summon this card from your hand, then add 1 Castle of Dark Illusions from your Deck to your hand.
effects.lua_implementation: A hand ignition requires a face-up exact Pumpking on the controller's field, then requires both a summon zone and exact Castle in Deck. It Special Summons the handler and only then searches/declares the Castle.

Concrete official ID/name used by the Deck search.

effects.printed_clause: You can Normal Summon it in addition to your Normal Summon/Set this turn.
effects.lua_implementation: After Castle is successfully added, the Lua registers EFFECT_EXTRA_SUMMON_COUNT through the End Phase, targeting only exact Castle.

official_references.matched_structure: Grants one additional Normal Summon/Set during the current turn with EFFECT_EXTRA_SUMMON_COUNT.

effects.printed_clause: Also you can use monsters from your hand as Tribute for its Normal Summon.
effects.lua_implementation: After Castle of Dark Illusions is added, it receives EFFECT_ADD_EXTRA_TRIBUTE through the End Phase with LOCATION_HAND as the additional Tribute pool and a releasable-monster filter.

official_references.matched_structure: Closest official structural reference: modifies which nonstandard cards can be Tributed for a specific Tribute Summon.
Closest official structural reference: supplies otherwise unavailable Tribute material through a summon-material rule effect.

effects.issue: Confirmed and corrected: the hand-Tribute permission was absent. Official Master Peace establishes EFFECT_ADD_EXTRA_TRIBUTE and its target-range/filter structure; the effect is attached only to the searched Castle.

effects.printed_clause: You can only use this effect of Pumpqueen the Queen of Ghosts once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: The combined summon/search/additional-Summon effect uses SetCountLimit(1,id), a hard once-per-turn.
